routine.name: Avisar contas a vencer nos próximos 7 dias
routine.description: Every morning, scans the last 30 days of Gmail for messages mentioning "boleto", "fatura", "invoice" or "vencimento", extracts a due date (dd/mm/yyyy) and a R$ amount from each, keeps only the ones whose due date falls within the next 7 days, uses a judgment to drop payment confirmations / receipts / marketing (keeping only bills that are still pending), and sends a single Telegram message listing each pending bill with its due date and amount plus the total owed. Sends nothing if no bill is due in the window.

judgments.isPendingBill: Is this email describing a bill, invoice, or boleto that is still unpaid and has an upcoming due date (as opposed to a payment confirmation, receipt for a completed payment, or marketing/newsletter content)?

routine.name: Unanswered Emails Morning Digest
routine.description: Every morning, scans the inbox for emails from real people that the user hasn't replied to and that have been sitting for more than 3 days. Automated/no-reply senders and messages that don't actually require a response are filtered out with a judgment. If any qualify, sends a single Telegram digest listing sender, subject, and how long it's been waiting, oldest first. Sends nothing if there's nothing to report.

judgments.needs_reply: Does this email genuinely need a reply from the user — i.e. it's from a real person and is asking something or requires action, not an automated notification, newsletter, receipt, or an FYI-only message?
